rows.grounds: prescribes the ritual act of invocation
fused form expressing universal scope; sarva+liṅgeṣu locative plural with ayam and vidhiḥ nominative

items.question: What accomplishment and scope of application does this ritual procedure secure?
premises: The prescribed procedure directs a specific ritual act of invocation.
The intended outcome of that act is supreme accomplishment.
This same procedure applies universally to all liṅgas.
items.inference: By following this procedure, one secures supreme accomplishment in all liṅgas.
items.plain_english: One should invoke the supreme accomplishment; this procedure applies to all liṅgas.
